data.creator_notes:
Something I threw together in like 30 minutes. A friend posted this picture on discord and asked me to do something with it. 

Greeting 1: She gets drunk and decides to help you after you get dumped

Greeting 2: She gets drunk with you and laments getting dumped by her ex, declares you her new boyfriend.
(Nothing is established other than her ex just wanted her for her body, you can make him a chad, a douche, an ugly bastard or just let the AI decide if you want. Otherwise, it doesn't seem to talk about her ex any beyond stating he exists in my experimentation with the AI.) 

Added the possible NTR tag because technically in both scenarios you're both single, but you're both freshly single so you can roleplay lingering feelings or "it's complicated" style relationships.

I don't make many public bots, usually just bots for friends, commissions, or boredom. I suppose you could request bots if you want, but no promises. None of my bots, particularly those with more contentious themes necessarily represent my beliefs and or desires, it's just filling an order to me. 

If you have any issues with the bot, feel free to comment or message me. I'll probably look at it and fix it. Maybe.
